text_block_list.text:
While waiting for Mejiro Ryan, who hadn't 
shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer! Taking time off out of 
nowhere like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I ended up getting lost in conversation 
with an underclassman. And so—

As I pondered how to respond to an 
apologizing Mejiro Ryan, another Umamusume 
walked into the room.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, please don't scold Ryan-senpai! It's 
my fault!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I mistakenly thought Senpai had the day 
off today, so I asked her for some diet 
advice—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah! I told you you didn't have to come...!

choice_data_list: Just be careful starting next time, okay?

text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro Ryan is deeply adored by 
her juniors.
